context: A boss and his deputy read social-affairs headlines
purpose: Teach: 閉鎖/破綻/放棄/収容/虐待/誘導/消滅/陥っ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今朝の新聞、また地方の病院が閉鎖されたらしいぞ。
lines.en: In this morning's paper, another rural hospital has apparently been shut down.
lines.style: Gruff senior boss skimming the morning paper aloud.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ええ、経営破綻が原因だそうですね。患者の受け入れ先がもう限界らしいです。
lines.en: Yes, financial collapse was the cause. The facilities accepting patients are reportedly at their limit.
lines.style: Polite mid-career deputy summarizing the article respectfully.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 近隣の施設で収容しきれるのか、心配だな。
lines.en: Whether the neighboring facilities can actually accommodate them all, that worries me.
lines.style: Concerned older manager voicing practical doubt.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: それから、児童虐待の通報がまた過去最多を更新したと書いてあります。
lines.en: Also, reports of child abuse have once again hit a record high, it says here.
lines.style: Deputy turning the page, reading another grim headline.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ひどい話だ。親が責任を放棄してるとしか思えん。
lines.en: It's a terrible story. I can only think that the parents are abandoning their responsibility.
lines.style: Boss exhaling heavily, blunt and disapproving.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 行政が相談窓口へ誘導する仕組みを強化するそうですが、人手不足で混乱に陥っているとか。
lines.en: The government plans to strengthen the system guiding people to counseling, but it's mired in staff shortages.
lines.style: Deputy explaining policy details in calm formal tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: このままじゃ、地方のコミュニティそのものが消滅しかねないな。
lines.en: At this rate, the very fabric of regional communities may well disappear.
lines.style: Boss grave, leaning back with arms folded.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 本当に。午後の会議で、この件にも少し触れておきましょうか。
lines.en: Truly so. Shall we touch on this issue briefly at the afternoon meeting too?
lines.style: Deputy gently steering back to work duties.
